the original reference solution (which satisfies the task), and a modified solution
(as a unified diff plus the full changed files). Decide whether the modified solution
still satisfies every requirement that the task text states or clearly implies.

Answer "violating" if it breaks at least one requirement (name it), "preserving" if it
satisfies all of them, or "unsure" if you cannot tell. Judge only against the task
text: a change in formatting, naming, ordering, or implementation is "preserving"
unless the task text requires the exact form that changed. A change that makes the
solution crash, produce a different result, skip a required step, write to the wrong
place, or omit required output is "violating". You are not told how the task is
graded and must not guess; do not reward or penalize anything for how a checker might
react.
Return for each item: {"verdict": "violating"|"preserving"|"unsure",
"requirement": "<the broken requirement, or empty>", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.

--- a/_gp_transform.py
+++ b/_gp_transform.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+"""graderproof output transform (spec-preserving variant)."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+OP = 'stdout-trailing-newline'
+TARGETS = []
+
+
+def toggle_newline(text):
+    return text[:-1] if text.endswith("\n") else text + "\n"
+
+
+def trailing_spaces(text):
+    return "\n".join(line + "  " if line else line for line in text.split("\n"))
+
+
+def reorder(obj):
+    if isinstance(obj, dict):
+        return {k: reorder(obj[k]) for k in reversed(list(obj))}
+    if isinstance(obj, list):
+        return [reorder(x) for x in obj]
+    return obj
+
+
+def floatify(obj):
+    if isinstance(obj, bool):
+        return obj
+    if isinstance(obj, int):
+        return float(obj)
+    if isinstance(obj, dict):
+        return {k: floatify(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
+    if isinstance(obj, list):
+        return [floatify(x) for x in obj]
+    return obj
+
+
+def rewrite_json(text, fn, indent):
+    end = "\n" if text.endswith("\n") else ""
+    return json.dumps(fn(json.loads(text)), indent=indent) + end
+
+
+def transform_file(text):
+    if OP == "out-trailing-newline":
+        return toggle_newline(text)
+    if OP == "out-trailing-spaces":
+        return trailing_spaces(text)
+    if OP == "out-json-key-order":
+        return rewrite_json(text, reorder, 2)
+    if OP == "out-json-indent":
+        return rewrite_json(text, lambda o: o, 4)
+    if OP == "out-json-float":
+        return rewrite_json(text, floatify, 2)
+    return text
+
+
+def main():
+    captured = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+    out = captured.read_text() if captured.exists() else ""
+    if OP.startswith("out-"):
+        for name in TARGETS:
+            path = pathlib.Path(name)
+            if path.is_file():
+                path.write_text(transform_file(path.read_text()))
+    elif OP == "stdout-json-key-order" and out.strip():
+        out = rewrite_json(out, reorder, None)
+    elif OP == "stdout-code-fence" and out.strip():
+        out = "```json\n" + out.rstrip("\n") + "\n```\n"
+    elif OP == "stdout-trailing-newline" and out:
+        out = toggle_newline(out)
+    sys.stdout.write(out)
+
+
+main()
